, was a map located in a city soccer court. It was the event map for the second mission of the
. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on the player count. It has no unique rewards.

You only got cash if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this was reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it was a decimal number, it got rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down.
All difficulties had health scaling of 10% in trio matches and 20% in quad matches. In the Hard difficulty,
was applied, which increased the health of an enemy by 10% every wave after its first appearance, also boosting rewards by 20%. In both difficulties, players could not use their

was a soccer court placed in the middle of a city. The court had a blue floor with white lines and was surrounded by short metal fences on the sides and taller ones on the front and back. Behind the fences there were benches, multiple spotlights and bystanders watching the court. On the front and back there were stairs leading out of the court. Next to them were a few trees. These stairs lead to the city itself, which contained multiple colorful buildings with billboards on them which displayed Roblox ads.
The path started at one goal to the other. The path took multiple long straights followed by quick turns.
This map only had one preset loadout with no option to choose your own. Because of this, every player would use the following loadout.
